plan.hypothesis: Analytically registering a plain SwinIR prediction to its LR observation by one bounded global subpixel translation will improve frozen Urban100-12 mean paired PSNR-Y by at least 0.05 dB versus the fixed two-pass horizontal-flip reference while keeping candidate/reference latency at or below 2.5 times.
plan.mechanism: A small spatial displacement creates first-order luminance error along many Urban100 edges. The candidate area-reduces the plain SR luminance, estimates one global translation to the observed LR luminance by windowed phase correlation, bounds the corresponding HR displacement to 0.5 pixel per axis, rejects estimates with response below 0.10, and applies the accepted translation jointly to RGB. This changes geometry rather than amplitudes or frequency strength. The inference that a global registration correction may help this fixed PSNR-oriented SwinIR pipeline is mine; the cited papers do not test this postprocessor.
plan.baseline: Comparator is the existing fixed two-pass horizontal-flip SwinIR-S x2 reference. The candidate path uses exactly one plain SwinIR prediction and then one inexpensive array-only global registration warp; it neither obtains nor combines a second prediction.
plan.why_not_g1_retry: This is not G1: it does not flip, ensemble, average, or call another forward. It is not LR-versus-SR residual backprojection because no photometric residual is added back and there are no iterative data-consistency updates. It is not weak-high-frequency attenuation or its sign reversal: there is no blur-derived frequency gate, shrinkage, or sharpening. It does not expand global luminance contrast, compress or expand gamut/chroma, estimate/remove additive 2x2 phase-locked luminance bias, choose RGB quantization-lattice corners, or merely clip. It does not retune any stopped constant. It instead estimates and corrects a continuous image-global geometric translation. Because the candidate/reference comparison also changes one versus two forwards, an outcome cannot isolate translation causality.

new_evidence.claim: Ma et al. report that geometric structural distortions occur in super-resolved images and that explicit gradient/structure guidance improves their tested SR systems on multiple metrics including PSNR.
new_evidence.why_distinct: This motivates treating spatial structure as an error source; my inference is to test a training-free global translation correction, not their trained gradient branch and not any stopped photometric route.

new_evidence.claim: Song et al. report that LR-guided upsampling based on local color relationships can preserve detail effects while suppressing bleeding and blurring across tested image operators.
new_evidence.why_distinct: This supports the general use of the observed LR image as structural guidance. My candidate uses it only for geometric registration, not learned/interpolated pixel replacement, residual backprojection, or an ensemble.

controls: Twelve Urban100 x2 pairs selected by fixed study-id/filename hash excluding historical and local reserved IDs, before search; no image or score selection
Candidate: plain fixed SwinIR-S x2 prediction followed by one agent-authored deterministic array function
Comparator: existing fixed two-pass horizontal-flip SwinIR-S x2 reference; no optimization or reopening G1
CPU float32, four reference threads, same weights, official padding, RGB/uint8 conversion, Y metric, border crop 2
No training, extra weights, model forwards in candidate code, parameter sweeps, repeated holdout access, or automatic retries
All constants frozen in candidate.py and research.json before registration; synthetic checks only before registration
plan.stop_route: A valid negative eliminates one-shot image-global phase-correlation registration of plain SR to area-reduced LR luminance with a 0.10 response guard and a 0.5-HR-pixel per-axis bound; it does not justify retuning the guard, bound, window, interpolation, estimator, or adding local/adaptive registration complexity.

parameters.luminance: BT.601 weights [0.299, 0.587, 0.114], matching a conventional structure-bearing scalar projection
parameters.reduction: cv2 INTER_AREA from 2x SR to LR size, appropriate for reduction
parameters.registration: single cv2 phaseCorrelate call with a 2D Hann window; no candidate search or iteration
parameters.rationale: The tight half-pixel HR cap limits interpolation damage while allowing a material subpixel correction; the fixed low response guard disables poorly determined translations. All constants were chosen before holdout access.

plan.observable_output: For a reliable nonzero phase-correlation estimate, warpAffine interpolates neighboring float32 RGB samples at displaced coordinates; on gradients this crosses one or more 1/255 quantization thresholds, so Q(warp(sr)) is not algebraically equal to Q(sr). Synthetic review cases can therefore observe changed uint8 output. Clipping remains only the evaluator's normal downstream handling and is not the intervention.
plan.decision_rule: PASS only if all three conjunctive gates hold: mean paired PSNR-Y gain >= 0.05 dB AND the paired-bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound > 0 AND candidate/reference latency <= 2.5. A valid failure of any gate means STOP without tuning or retry. An invalid measurement is not scientific evidence and also receives no retry.
